def inject_basic_program(self, ascii_listing):
        """
        save the given ASCII BASIC program listing into the emulator RAM.
        """
        # make sure the emulator is reset
        self.reset_emulator()

        # write the BASIC program to the emulator RAM
        self.emulator_ram.write_ascii_listing(ascii_listing)

        # return the emulator state
        return self.emulator_ram.get_emulator_state()
